settings.q: Can you model our specific tank or equipment?
settings.a: Yes. Send drawings, GA plans or photos of the unit and we'll build an accurate branded scale model of your exact tank or equipment.

settings.q: Can we order several as corporate gifts?
settings.a: Yes - matched batches for gifting and exhibitions are our speciality. Send a commission inquiry with your quantity.

settings.q: Does it include a display case?
settings.a: Yes, a clear protective case and finished black wooden base are included.

settings.hero_desc: An industrial horizontal storage tank model - a precise, skid-mounted scale replica reproduced in detail with manway, pipework, valves and branded end caps, presented under a clear display case. A professional showcase and corporate gift for equipment-rental, oil & gas, water and industrial firms that want to present their fleet in miniature.
settings.s1_body: Hard to bring a industrial horizontal storage tank model into a meeting? We build it in miniature instead. This industrial horizontal storage tank model reproduces your real unit down to its shell, manway, pipework, valves and branding, finished under a clear case so it stays pristine on a desk, reception counter or exhibition stand. The ideal showcase piece and corporate gift for equipment-rental, oil & gas, water and engineering firms.
settings.case_body: Commissioned by byrne equipment company, these models let the team showcase their units at exhibitions and gift them to clients - a tangible, branded reminder of the kit they provide, far more memorable than a brochure.
settings.case_quote: Our clients loved to see a miniature of the exact unit we supply. Great talking point at every meeting.
settings.prov_p: You cannot put a containerised plant or storage tank on a boardroom table - but you can put its model there. A scale replica brings the product into the room and keeps your brand on the desk long after the meeting.
